title: Cost Accountant
company: The Global Institute for Health and Human Rights
description:

 Full\-time
   

  

 Apply Now
   

  

 Join our dynamic team, where you will play a key role in managing our accounting procedures. We’re seeking a detail\-oriented, motivated individual who excels in a collaborative environment. Under limited supervision, you will assist Accounting management in performing multiple duties related to the accounting functions of the organization within established deadlines. You will also maintain accounting procedures associates with cost accounting while providing backup for other accounting functions as necessary.
   

  

**P
 **rimary Responsibilities:****
* Support with daily activities to be J\-SOX compliant;
* Compile quarterly reports for our mother company;
* Assist in compiling year\-end audited financial statements under IFRS standards with eliminations;
* Compile K\-Group and consolidated budgets and long\-term plans on an as requested basis;
* Assist in compiling financial analytics on an as requested basis;
* Create reports to assist management on ways to manage costs;
* Help production management identify cost drivers and cost reduction plans;
* Is aware and accepts the responsibility regarding internal controls and compliance with JSOX.


****Other Responsibilities:****
* Other accounting functions, but not limited to budgeting, fixed assets, material costing, physical inventory valuations, month end, census surveys, and year end activities.


****Requirements:****
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or five years of equivalent accounting experience;
* Strong understanding of cost accounting principles and practices;
* Proficiency in MS Excel and other accounting software; experience with Plex is a plus;
* Excellent analytical and mathematical skills;
* Ability to excel in a team environment;
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.


****Career Growth:****
* Advancement opportunities
* Education reimbursement for continued learning
* Training and development programs


****Great Benefit Package:****
* Medical, dental, prescription drug, and vision insurance
* Life insurance
* 401(k) plan with company match
* Vacation/holiday/shutdown pay
* Short\-term and long\-term disability
* Flexible spending account
* Associate assistance program
* Incentive Programs (attendance, safety, quality, delivery)
* Company\-provided uniforms and laundry service
* Wellness/Fitness Program
* Safety Boot subsidies
* Educational Assistance Program
* Company\-sponsored special events
* Full\-service cafeteria


****Company Overview:****
 KTH Parts Industries, Inc. is based in St. Paris, Ohio, and operates as a Tier 1 automotive supplier of underbody structural parts, catering to automotive companies worldwide. Our K\-Group team comprises over 2,000 engineering and manufacturing associates involved in various stages of automotive component development, including product development, analysis, formability, prototyping, production stamping, forming, robotic welding, assembly, and part shipment. At KTH, we employ cutting\-edge applications to simulate and analyze the manufacturability of designs. Our technical expertise and reliable support enable us to deliver high\-quality, high\-performance automotive products that require exceptional technical proficiency to improve, operate, and maintain.
   

  

 KTH Parts Industries is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. We respect and appreciate every individual’s qualifications, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.
